# From a visual intention to a controllable method

Keep three kinds of statements separate:

| Layer | Example | How to work with it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Observation | Fine, sparse trails turn gradually across broad regions. | Describe visible marks, spacing, direction, rhythm and scale. |
| Mechanism | Paths integrate a direction field. | Select and implement a specific method; many methods can yield a similar appearance. |
| Interpretation | The maker wants calm currents or a sense of collective movement. | Keep it attributed to the maker and context; ask what a viewer reads. |

Use the [interactive exercises](https://thevibesarepeople.com/vocabulary/) to compare flow, cohesion, interference, branching, grain and subdivision. These are teaching terms, not fixed symbols or exclusive ownership of an aesthetic. A reference to an artist should lead to their specific contribution and chosen name, not a generic style token.

Translate each chosen quality into an honest control:

- Density: number of elements per fixed area; keep the earlier elements stable when adding more, where appropriate.
- Field scale: how far a direction stays similar; distinguish this from canvas resolution and mark thickness.
- Turning: how strongly local direction bends a path; distinguish it from animation speed.
- Grain: mark size, spacing or distribution; identify which is changing.
- Branching: angle, length ratio, depth and rule choice; a recursive branch sketch is not automatically an L-system.
- Cohesion: a neighbor rule and its radius/weight; clustered dots alone are not a Boids simulation.
- Interference: relative spacing, angle, frequency and phase; name the actual construction.

Choose the few controls that serve the request. State their ranges, defaults and visible effects. Hold seed and other inputs fixed, compare one change, then ask whether the result supports the intended reading.

## Method names are implementation promises

Perlin noise, curl noise, value noise and an interpolated direction grid are different mechanisms. Use the name that the code implements. A curl-free or divergence-free claim requires the corresponding construction and a test; resemblance to fluid motion is insufficient. A reference image cannot establish which method or person produced it.

Read `methods.json` for a dated subset of the project’s credited contributions, source URLs and review status. Follow the primary source before presenting a historical assertion as verified. Imported credits still need checking. If a source is inaccessible, keep its status visible and deliver the artwork with that limitation. A sparse archive is not a reason to exclude an experimenter.
